transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because I've been having this problem. After I eat too much, I keep going to the bathroom and making myself throw up. I just do it so I won't gain weight. But... it's gotten to the point where I'm honestly scared I can't stop doing it.
When you have these episodes where you make yourself throw up, do you find that you are eating an amount of food that most other people would consider unusually large?

Yeah, I do. Usually it happens at night, um, after everyone's gone quiet in the house. I'll just stand there in the kitchen and eat whatever's around. Leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream... really just whatever is there. I keep going way past what anyone would call a normal meal. By the time I'm done, it honestly looks like half the pantry has been picked over.
